algorithm: 3D Diffusion Policy (DP3, downstream IL); Mink differential IK (fingertip-position retargeting)
success_criterion: Rotating-and-Placing-the-Carton: "successful if the carton rotates more than 45 degrees and is successfully placed into the bucket"; Bottle-Slipping (no visual): bottle slips without falling within a 15-second countdown
headline_metric: task success rate vs. AnyTeleop baseline (10 trials)
headline_value: Rotating-and-Placing-the-Carton (Table III, 10 trials): Haptic+Force 10/10 @ 19.89s vs. AnyTeleop 1/10 @ 54.85s; IL (DP3): Press and Move Box 17/20 (85%), Pick and Place Teddy Bear 14/20 (70%), Rotating and Placing the Carton 9/10 (90%, from 3 demos)
note_gaps: no cost-function equation given anywhere (not even an unrecovered image) — the paper delegates the IK solve to the third-party Mink library and states no paper-original objective
operator_interface: haptic force-feedback exoskeleton glove (21-DoF encoder-based motion capture, 5-DoF cable-driven force feedback, per-fingertip LRA haptic feedback), plus an HTC Vive Tracker for wrist localization; not vision-based
retargeting_objective: map glove-FK fingertip positions to robot fingertip targets via the third-party Mink differential-IK solver, with a single scalar hand-size scaling factor; no paper-original cost function
latency: 30 Hz minimum system rate (120 Hz mocap, 30 Hz haptics)
